title: Residual Fusion for Low-Resource Image Classification

paragraphs.text: We study residual fusion for image classification when labelled data are scarce. The method adds a residual fusion block to a standard convolutional backbone and keeps the training budget fixed.
We use ResNet-50 as the backbone and train on ImageNet-1k for 90 epochs with a batch size of 256. The residual fusion block is inserted after the third stage.
All main experiments use ImageNet-1k. We report top-1 accuracy on the official validation split.
Residual fusion reaches 76.8% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1k, which is 2.1 points above the ResNet-50 baseline.
Removing the fusion block drops top-1 accuracy by 3.4 points, so the gain is not a training artefact.
Residual fusion gives a small but consistent gain at the same training cost. We do not claim gains at larger scale.
